angle: A lighthouse keeper waits for one returning boat
title: The light that answered
post: Every night she lit the lamp for boats she would never meet. Tonight, someone remembered the way back. An original miniature, best watched with sound.

scenes.change: The lighthouse pulses over empty water.
scenes.sound: Original bell phrase over a quiet tide
scenes.heading: One light stayed on.
scenes.line: [Low tide, distant bell] One light stayed on.
scenes.caption: [Low tide, distant bell] One light stayed on.

scenes.picture: A smaller light answers from the water.
scenes.sound: Original bell phrase over a quiet tide
scenes.heading: The light that answered
scenes.line: [A higher note] A smaller light answers from the water.

scenes.change: The boat reaches the pier and both lights hold.
